description: browser-test: block non-read-only browser commands from the browser-tester and browser-test-planner agents. finding-verifier, pr-reviewer, spec-reviewer, standards-reviewer, design-reviewer, and deepening-scout: allow only read-only git, gh, rg, and text commands. Read-only agents with memory: file writes only under their own agent-memory/<agent>/ directory. Every other caller passes through untouched. A structured question (AskUserQuestion, Grok ask_user_question, Codex request_user_input, agy ask_question) and Notification: in Ghostty, ring the bell so the tab shows 🔔 while Claude waits on the user. SessionStart: in a bare Laravel worktree (no vendor/), point the agent at laravel-herd-worktrees' bootstrap; silent everywhere else.
